fullHistory.content: Give a brief, friendly welcome overview of what you can help with in this project. Use markdown with emoji section headers. Cover: Poses & Movement, Physics Simulation, Joint & Hand Control, and Code & Controls. Never use the word "Animations" — always say "Physics Simulation" instead. Keep it concise around 8–10 lines.

## 👋 Welcome to Your Roba Studio Project!

- **🤸‍♂️ Poses & Movement** – Quickly set robot poses using the `data.ctrl` array (e.g., raise arms, nod head).  
- **🧩 Physics Simulation** – Leverage MuJoCo’s realistic dynamics for stable collisions, gravity, and joint limits.  
- **🤲 Joint & Hand Control** – Precise control of each joint and finger actuator, with the correct sign conventions for left/right arms.  
- **💻 Code & Controls** – Edit `src/main.js` to script behaviors, add keyboard shortcuts, or create custom controllers.  

Just let me know what you’d like to tweak or build, and I’ll help you get it running smoothly in Roba Studio!
